title: Green sea turtle (Florida Keys)
text: Green turtles graze the seagrass of Biscayne Bay and nest and feed around the Dry Tortugas. They travel along the Florida reef tract between the two.
when: Adults nest in summer and travel between feeding and nesting sites; hatchlings go to sea.
matters: Turtles graze seagrass, which keeps it healthy. They need both safe nesting beaches and seagrass beds.
